articles.summary: 针对扩散式 drafter 在 speculative decoding 中并行生成多个 token 但缺乏上下文校正的问题，提出并行草稿的上下文校正方法，利用目标模型上下文提升草稿质量，从而加速 LLM 推理。

articles.title: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
articles.excerpt: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. articles.title: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code
